crossRefs.note: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on…
He said to them, “What man is there among you, who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day…
“What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go…
Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn…
I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us…
My people have been lost sheep. Their shepherds have caused them to go astray. They have turned them away on the…
“As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals…
“ ‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.
As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out…
“I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was…
You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”
“What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go…
If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone…
even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.
I have other sheep, which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become…
But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.
For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

translations.web: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep, and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness, and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?
translations.bsb: “What man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the pasture and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?
translations.kjv: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
translations.asv: What man of you, having a hundred sheep, and having lost one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
